import hashlib, json, stat, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path
root = Path("/home/jacob/capturesuite-current-receiving-7879c2abc07f-20261008")
source = root / "source"
base = root / "evidence" / "attempt-2"
manifest_raw = (root / "incoming-manifest.json").read_bytes()
manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
expected = {e["path"]: e for e in manifest["entries"]}
receipt_raw = (base / "receiving.json").read_bytes()
receipt = json.loads(receipt_raw)
xml_raw = (base / "pytest.xml").read_bytes()
xml = ET.fromstring(xml_raw)
cases = xml.findall(".//testcase")
failure_cases = [c.get("name") for c in cases if c.find("failure") is not None or c.find("error") is not None]
skip_cases = [{"name":c.get("name"), "reason":c.find("skipped").get("message")} for c in cases if c.find("skipped") is not None]
by_module = {}
for c in cases:
    key = c.get("classname")
    by_module.setdefault(key, {"cases":0,"passed":0,"skipped":0})
    by_module[key]["cases"] += 1
    by_module[key]["skipped"] += int(c.find("skipped") is not None)
    by_module[key]["passed"] += int(all(c.find(k) is None for k in ("skipped","failure","error")))
origins_raw = (base / "actual-import-origins.json").read_bytes()
origins = json.loads(origins_raw)
origin_mismatches = []
for name,item in origins["modules"].items():
    path = Path(item["path"]).resolve()
    if not path.is_relative_to(source):
        origin_mismatches.append({"module":name, "reason":"outside"})
        continue
    relative = path.relative_to(source).as_posix()
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    actual_blob = hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest()
    if relative not in expected or actual_blob != expected[relative]["sha"] or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()!=item["sha256"]:
        origin_mismatches.append({"module":name, "reason":"unmatched_source", "path":relative})
source_mismatches = []
for relative,item in expected.items():
    p=source/relative
    raw=p.read_bytes()
    actual={"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"bytes":len(raw),"gitBlob":hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest(),"mode":stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)}
    if actual!=receipt["sourceBefore"].get(relative) or actual!=receipt["sourceAfter"].get(relative) or actual["gitBlob"]!=item["sha"] or actual["mode"]!=(0o755 if item["mode"]=="100755" else 0o644):
        source_mismatches.append(relative)
actual_files = {p.relative_to(source).as_posix() for p in source.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
phases = []
stdout=(base/"pytest.stdout").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
for line in stdout.splitlines():
    prefix="CAPTURE_QC_IMPORT_RECEIVING "
    if line.startswith(prefix):
        phase=json.loads(line[len(prefix):])
        child=phase["child"]
        phases.append({"phase":phase["phase"],"exit":phase["exit"],"stateUnchanged":phase["stateUnchanged"],"apiFile":child["apiFile"],"modulesBefore":child["modulesBefore"],"modulesAfter":child["modulesAfter"],"nativeJobsFile":child.get("nativeJobsFile"),"reviewModuleFile":child.get("reviewModuleFile"),"jobIdentity":child.get("jobIdentity"),"qcIdentity":child.get("qcIdentity")})
files = ["receiving.json","pytest.xml","actual-import-origins.json","pytest.stdout","pytest.stderr"]
hashes = {f:{"bytes":(base/f).stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256((base/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in files}
